hero.standfirst: Plan your Panchakarma stay in Kerala with your doctor, with time for prescribed care, meals, yoga and rest in the village gardens.

faq.q: How long is the Panchakarma programme?
faq.a: The Panchakarma programme is offered as a 14–21 night stay. Your doctor will assess your needs and confirm the recommended duration and therapies. Discuss preparation, the time you have available and any follow-up before booking your travel; a shorter visit should not be assumed to provide the same programme.

faq.q: Is the initial doctor consultation free?
faq.a: Yes. Your initial doctor consultation is free. Share your health history, current medicines and goals, and ask whether a stay may suit you. This does not make treatment, tests, medicines or later consultations free. Ask the team to explain the charges that apply before you book.

faq.q: Will I have all five Panchakarma procedures?
faq.a: Not automatically. Panchakarma refers to five classical Ayurvedic procedures, but your doctor decides which are appropriate after assessing your health, medicines and needs. The doctor explains the proposed procedures, their preparation and availability. Ask what your individual plan involves before you decide on a stay.

faq.q: What determines the cost of my stay?
faq.a: Your quotation depends on the programme, length of stay, travel dates and villa occupancy. Ask for a breakdown of the included care and extras, including medicines, tests, specialist therapies, private sessions and transport. Review the full plan with our team before you confirm your booking.

faq.q: What will I eat and do during my stay?
faq.a: Your programme combines prescribed therapies, vegetarian meals, yoga, meditation and time to rest. Your doctor advises on diet and reviews your care during the stay. The village also offers walks, lectures and garden visits. Discuss which activities fit your treatment schedule rather than trying to fill every hour.

faq.q: What should I arrange before travelling?
faq.a: Speak with the doctor about your health and the time you can set aside, then confirm your programme, dates and accommodation. Tell our team if you need help with airport transfers or have questions about access. Bring your medical records and current medicine details to the consultation.

## Plan the whole Panchakarma stay

Ask about preparation, the recommended length of stay, dietary guidance and the routine to follow afterwards. Use your initial consultation to relate the programme to your own health and available time. A stay does not automatically include every classical procedure.

Patient accounts on this page describe individual experiences. They do not predict your response to treatment; suitability and outcomes vary.

Kairali · Palakkad, Kerala

## Panchakarma treatment in Kerala

Doctor-guided Ayurveda at Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village

The 14–21 night Ayurvedic Panchakarma therapy package

Ayurvedic heritage

“ A 2-week stay at the Kairali Ayurvedic Healing Village worked wonders with my health. Feel like a completely new person. In the lap of tropical nature and in the care of expert Ayurvedic doctors, there is no other option but to get completely rejuvenated. The best Panchakarma therapy one can get. ”

### Michaela, Iceland

Start with your needs

## Is Panchakarma right for you?

A consultation helps you understand whether the programme suits your health, available time and goals.

### Your health history

Discuss your symptoms, existing diagnoses, medicines and previous treatment with the Ayurvedic doctor.

### Your daily routine

Talk about sleep, food, activity and stress so your care plan reflects how you live.

### Your time for care

Ask about the proposed therapies, preparation, length of stay and follow-up before making travel arrangements.

Your treatment plan

## Personalised Panchakarma care

Your Ayurvedic doctor assesses your needs and decides which procedures are appropriate. The programme combines prescribed therapies, dietary guidance and time to rest, with progress reviewed during your stay.

Individual assessment before therapies begin

A prescribed diet and daily routine

Yoga and meditation adapted to your programme

Advice for continuing your routine after discharge

## Understanding Panchakarma

Panchakarma refers to five classical Ayurvedic procedures. Your doctor explains the proposed procedures, their preparation and whether they are suitable for you; a stay does not automatically include all five.

### Vamanam

A physician-supervised emesis procedure.

### Virechanam

A physician-supervised purgation procedure.

### Vasti

A prescribed enema procedure.

### Nasyam

A procedure involving prescribed nasal administration.

### Raktamokshana

A classical bloodletting procedure. Ask your doctor about suitability and availability.

Our fourth-generation Ayurvedic family brings its tradition of care to Kairali – The Ayurvedic Healing Village in Palakkad, Kerala.

Ayurvedic hospital

## Why Choose Us?

### Independent villas

Residential accommodation in the village gardens, with several villa categories to choose from.

### Personal consultation

Your doctor assesses your health history, discusses your goals and reviews your care.

### Space for daily routines

Yoga, meditation, meals and rest fit around your prescribed treatment schedule.

### Trained therapy team

Trained therapists deliver the sessions prescribed by your Ayurvedic doctor.

### Ayurvedic medicines

Your doctor explains any medicines prescribed as part of your individual plan.

### An organic garden

Explore the village’s garden and the ingredients used in its food and Ayurvedic traditions.

## Awards & Accreditations

Get to know Kairali’s accreditations and recognitions as you plan your Ayurvedic stay. Meet the doctors, hear from previous guests and explore what your programme includes before speaking with our patient care team.

NABH accreditation — recognised since 2018

### PATWA 2026

Kairali - The Ayurvedic Healing Village was honoured with the PATWA International Travel Award 2026 in the category “Best Retreat Wellness (India)” at ITB Berlin, the world’s largest travel trade show.

### National Geographic Traveller — Spa & Wellness Collection 2026

Featured in the 2026 Spa & Wellness Collection, recognising Kairali’s place among international wellness destinations.

### Tripadvisor Travelers’ Choice 2026

Recognition based on traveller reviews of their stays.

### Quality Partner- Lotus Travel | Ayurveda 2026

Kairali - The Ayurvedic Healing Village has been recognized as a Quality Partner (Ayurveda 2026) by Lotus Travel, affirming trusted standards in Ayurvedic stays.

## Your Ayurvedic Panchakarma package

### A 14–21 night stay at Kairali, Kerala

Detox inside out with a doctor-guided Ayurvedic Panchakarma programme. Stay in an independent villa, follow a personalised vegetarian diet and make time for yoga, meditation and daily consultations.

Your doctor will plan the therapies around your needs and review your progress during the stay.

### What your stay includes

Independent villa accommodation

Vegetarian breakfast, lunch and dinner, as advised by your doctor

Two Ayurvedic therapies per person each day

Om chanting sessions

Yoga, meditation, lectures, village walks and organic garden tours

Lifestyle and fitness evaluation, with access to the swimming pool, library and gym

Herbal drinking water throughout your stay

Ask for the Panchakarma treatment itinerary, available villa categories and a personalised quotation for your dates.

## What our patients are saying

### Jaswinder Kaur

### Amazing!! The only word for KAIRALI

This retreat is beautiful the staff are very friendly and helpful. There's so much nature around you its refreshing and a amazing view.

We visited in December 2021 and we fell in love with this place so much so that we will try to go there on yearly basis. We really recommend you to visit its a great experience

### Shreya Jain

### Rejuvenating experience!

It’s the most authentic and best place of ayurvedic treatment. They provide with the best treatments and best therapists.

Everything in the resort is controlled by the doctors. They serve the healthiest food in the most delicious way. The property has an amazing yoga centre, organic farm, gym, recreation room, swimming pool, tennis court, canteen and ayurvedic treatment centre. It feels like living in nature with 5 star facilities.

### Kajal Kothari

### Rejuvenating experience!

Kairali the Healing Village offers a rejuvenating holiday with lush surroundings & peaceful atmosphere. Treatments, organic meals, gym, yoga, and meditation are all based on Ayurveda principles.

I loved my stay in the villa designed based on my zodiac sign and vastu shastra. Professional staff and a doctor consultation before treatments ensured a relaxing and rejuvenating experience. I highly recommend it for all

### Vibhutee Kohli

### Home Away From Home!

My stay at Kairali was amazing - like a second home. The peaceful atmosphere and nature made it the perfect place for my father's treatment.

The resort exceeded expectations with knowledgeable staff, delicious meals, and a serene environment. The staff went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable. I'm grateful for the rejuvenating experience and the kindness of the Kairali family. Thank you, Kairali !

### Mahender Chaudhary

### Life time Experience to Change Your Life

Kairali is an excellent, authentic Ayurvedic healing resort that offers a life-changing experience. The staff is cooperative and provides excellent services.

The peaceful atmosphere and highly qualified doctors help you feel relaxed and rejuvenated. I highly recommend a visit for anyone looking to live a healthier lifestyle.

“Kairali Ayurvedic Healing Village has a distinctive advantage of having Dr Deepu as an experienced doctor whose diagnosis and treatment methods are spot on that helps you heal your body. Today, after my panchakarma treatment advised by him has helped me live a happy life & bringing more efficiency in my work & personal life.”

## Frequently Asked Questions

Which health concerns can I discuss?

Tell your doctor about your symptoms, diagnoses, current medicines and treatment goals. The doctor will assess whether Panchakarma or another programme is appropriate; suitability and outcomes vary.

Who is Panchakarma suitable for?

Suitability depends on your health, age, medicines and the proposed procedures. An individual medical assessment is needed before a programme is prescribed.

Will I notice immediate results?

Responses and timing vary. Discuss realistic goals, the proposed duration and how progress will be reviewed with your doctor.

What will I eat during my stay?

A vegetarian diet is prescribed for your programme. Your doctor will explain dietary guidance during treatment and after discharge.

Can I enquire without a diagnosed condition?

Yes. Explain your goals and health history during the consultation so the doctor can advise whether the programme is appropriate.
